reviewed.explanation: Discovery Agent installed on each VM can capture running processes and network connections alongside utilization; agentless collection cannot capture running processes.
reviewed.wrongOptions: B CloudWatch metrics and logs alone do not provide the full migration inventory and connection mapping. C Agentless VMware collector lacks running-process inventory. D Application Discovery Service does not discover arbitrary servers via firewall scans.

reviewed.explanation: SES SMTP requires TLS, via STARTTLS or TLS Wrapper. The stem states the legacy SMTP server does not support TLS, but does not establish whether the application SMTP client supports STARTTLS. B requires STARTTLS-capable client and SES SMTP credentials; if the client cannot negotiate TLS, a relay or SMTP client upgrade is needed. The answer must not be marked independently verified without clarifying that distinction.
reviewed.wrongOptions: A TLS Wrapper also requires TLS-capable SMTP client; IAM role does not replace SMTP credentials. C/D contradict SMTP-only application.

reviewed.explanation: Transit VIFs from separate Direct Connect connections can terminate on a shared Direct Connect gateway, which associates with Transit Gateways in both Regions. Direct Connect gateway is not a general TGW-to-TGW transit router; peer the Transit Gateways for inter-Region VPC communication.
reviewed.wrongOptions: A private VIF is not the correct connection type to a TGW. B separate DX gateways cannot peer. C DX gateway cannot provide TGW-to-TGW transit routing.
